summary: Greene County Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026 reporting the redemption of $10.0 million aggregate principal of its 3.00% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due September 15, 2031. The redemption price equaled 100% of principal plus accrued and unpaid interest to, but excluding, the redemption date; $20.0 million remains outstanding. The company funded the redemption with cash on hand. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The partial note retirement reduces regulatory capital and interest expense; watch for future capital actions or further note repurchases.
